trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) piercing damage.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) slashing damage.

action.name: Tail
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 11} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Frightful Presence
entries: Each creature of the dragon's choice that is within 120 feet of the dragon and aware of it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or become {@condition frightened} for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the dragon's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

action.name: Breath Weapons {@recharge 5}
entries: The dragon uses one of the following breath weapons.

items.name: Fire Breath
items.entry: The dragon exhales fire in a 60-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a {@dc 18} Dexterity saving throw, taking 45 ({@damage 13d6}) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

items.name: Sleep Breath
items.entry: The dragon exhales sleep gas in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must succeed on a {@dc 18} Constitution saving throw or fall {@condition unconscious} for 10 minutes. This effect ends for a creature if the creature takes damage or someone uses an action to wake it.

legendary.name: Detect
entries: The dragon makes a Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check.

legendary.name: Tail Attack
entries: The dragon makes a tail attack.

legendary.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
entries: The dragon beats its wings. Each creature within 10 feet of the dragon must succeed on a {@dc 19} Dexterity saving throw or take 13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) bludgeoning damage and be knocked {@condition prone}. The dragon can then fly up to half its flying speed.

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting
headerEntries: The dragon casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 16}):
will: {@spell Shapechange|SRD52} (Beast or Humanoid form only, no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52} gained from the spell, and no {@status Concentration|SRD52} or {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|SRD52} required to maintain the spell)

trait.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day, or 4/Day in Lair)
entries: If the dragon fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The dragon makes three Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) Sleep Breath or (B) Spellcasting to cast {@spell Scorching Ray|SRD52}.

action.name: Rend
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 11}, reach 10 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 2d10 + 6}) Slashing damage plus 4 ({@damage 1d8}) Fire damage.

action.name: Fire Breath {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Line}. {@actSaveFail} 45 ({@damage 10d8}) Fire damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

action.name: Sleep Breath
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 18}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|SRD52|Cone}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition Incapacitated|SRD52} condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it repeats the save. {@actSaveFail 2} The target has the {@condition Unconscious|SRD52} condition for 10 minutes. This effect ends for the target if it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

legendary.name: Blazing Light
entries: The dragon uses Spellcasting to cast {@spell Scorching Ray|SRD52}.

legendary.name: Pounce
entries: The dragon moves up to half its {@variantrule Speed|SRD52}, and it makes one Rend attack.

legendary.name: Scorching Sands
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 16}, one creature the dragon can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 27 ({@damage 6d8}) Fire damage, and the target's {@variantrule Speed|SRD52} is halved until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

Adult brass dragons know many secrets and have vast networks of contacts. These dragons share perspectives they've learned from across the world and passionately combat the lies of con artists and villains that lead people astray.

items.title: An adult brass dragon rids its new lair of unwelcome undead
